body.name: Legal full-support binary feedback witness
body.construction: In coordinate order \((0,0),(1,0),(0,1),(1,1)\), take \(\mathcal S=\mathcal A=\{0,1\}\), \(X_0=Z_0=0\), \(b\equiv0\), \(\pi\equiv1\), let \(o\) be the identity map, let \(r(z)=z\), take nominal one-probabilities \(p_{\mathrm{bin}}\), and use the response laws \(q_0,\nu_+,\nu_-,q_+,q_-\) declared above. This tuple is \(\mathfrak W_{\mathrm{bin}}\).
